note: RAB3A-related SCA52 exhibits overlapping cerebellar ataxia and spastic paraplegia phenotypes with prominent vermian cerebellar atrophy on MRI.

evidence.text: Affected individuals presented with progressive cerebellar symptoms accompanied by mild gait spasticity, and brain MRI consistently revealed cerebellar atrophy accentuated in the vermis.

source.title: An R83W mutation in Rab3A causes autosomal-dominant cerebellar ataxia
source.quote: Affected individuals presented with adult-onset, gradually progressive cerebellar symptoms, often accompanied by mild gait spasticity and tremors. Variable features of neurodevelopmental disorders were also observed. Brain MRI consistently revealed cerebellar atrophy, often accentuated in the vermis

evidence.text: RAB3A variants cause upper motor neuron signs and spasticity, placing the disorder directly within the overlapping ataxia-spasticity spectrum.

source.title: The RAB3A hot spot variant R83W causes spasticity as part of the ataxia-spasticity spectrum
source.quote: While the predominant feature remains cerebellar ataxia, we show upper motor neuron … phenotype within the spasticity-ataxia spectrum.
